setup: 1 OpenESC-20x20, channel 4 driven alone
Throttle ramp from 0 to full over 120 s, thermal limit disabled
Fan cooling, fresh pack
Reference: DC clamp meter on the battery lead
1 OpenESC-20x20, 1 motor driven from the bench controller
ESC trace: bench controller ADC reading of the current-sense output, gain 50 A/V
Reference: DC clamp meter on the battery lead
Six throttle holds of 8 to 20 s, 15 to 100 percent
OpenFC-Lite (RP2350B) blackbox logs from three airframes, 2026-08-09
ESC die temperature as reported over telemetry
Hottest retained flight of each airframe; the 8 inch on both 6S and 8S
1 OpenMotor-2306 on a 10 kg load cell, ESC reversed so the propeller pulls (operator-stated, not recorded in the capture)
Main run at 16:48 UTC: ten throttle holds of about 4 s, 10 to 100 percent, on one 6S pack reading 23.9 V at rest
Two earlier runs, pack A at 13:16 UTC (unplugged by the operator at 80 percent because of the noise) and pack B at 13:25 UTC, are drawn in the thrust and pack voltage figures only, to compare packs
Load cell calibrated against a 1726 g reference mass (207.4 counts/g, about 0.7 percent); zero drift 2 g before and 0.5 g after the run
Rotor speed is ESC eRPM divided by the 7 pole pairs stored in the capture
Pack voltage is the flight controller battery divider; the other electrical readings of the capture are uncalibrated and not shown
A capture at 16:35 UTC is not plotted: its zero drifted by up to 27 g and its ESC temperature was frozen by a pack swap
Run state: draft, not validated; no scope or clamp record.

log.tested: Thrust map at 16:48 UTC on one 6S pack: ten throttle holds, 10 to 100 percent.
log.saw: 1652 g at 31283 rpm at 100 percent throttle; pack 23.9 V at rest; ESC temperature live, 38 to 53 C; zero drift 2 g before, 0.5 g after. The 16:35 UTC capture is not used: zero drift up to 27 g and a frozen ESC temperature.
log.changed: ESC temperature now stays live after a pack swap.

log.tested: Thrust map on the new thrust stand: ten throttle holds, 10 to 100 percent.
log.saw: 13:25 UTC run: 1496 g at 100 percent. 13:16 UTC run: the operator unplugged the pack at 80 percent because of the noise, and the throttle profile kept stepping to full with no pack.
log.changed: The bench controller aborts when the bus voltage disappears under command. Stand test plans no longer include a current cut.

log.tested: Continuous current rating by a fixed-current step and the die temperature settling.
log.saw: Not captured. From the fitted thermal time constant of 5 to 10 minutes, 20 s at the target current gives only a few percent of the steady rise, so a pack step cannot reach steady state.
log.changed: The bench holds a target die temperature and reads the current needed.

log.tested: Review of the scope captures from the destructive ramp session.
log.saw: Scope channel 1 read one constant value in all nine sessions of that afternoon; no check flagged it.

log.tested: Throttle sweep against a clamp reference.
log.saw: The sense reading did not track the clamp: 11.6 A against 32.4 A at 80 percent, 64.7 A against 55.7 A at 100 percent.
log.changed: Input network added to the sense amplifier in rev3.2; no capture after the change.

log.tested: One channel ramped from 0 to full throttle with no thermal guard.
log.saw: Clamp current peaked at 39.8 A with the die at 156 C; the die reached 161 C and bus voltage telemetry stopped.

log.tested: First flights of the full stack on five drones.
log.saw: 103 blackbox logs from four drones, about half arm and disarm blips; the fifth drone's SD card failed. Seven logs on the 8 inch ran the FC on a separate battery, so their voltage is not pack voltage.

log.tested: Ride out to 5.3 km with a Gemini and a Mono on the same carry.
log.saw: Beyond 2.9 km the Gemini's RSSI was below the Mono's in 24 of 25 bins, by a median of 4 dB, and its link quality was higher in all 25, by a median of 15 points. Receiver columns come from the operators' notes; one duplicate column was excluded.
